verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim/ROS docs mention physics-based sensors, a ROS 2 bridge, and Isaac ROS 'ready-to-use packages for navigation and perception' with GPU-accelerated NITROS, implying camera/lidar sensor support and ROS 2 message compatibility, but the evidence never explicitly names IMU or GPS drivers or confirms standard ROS message-type coverage across all four sensor classes. missing for 10: explicit IMU/GPS driver packages, explicit standard message-type mapping, independent hands-on confirmation of driver breadth.
